body.statement: Can one construct a total feasible estimator and confidence interval that attain the exact asymptotic minimax constants for conditional mean squared error and uniformly honest conditional expected length at every intersection of the treated-mean and fixed-design optimal-recovery channels in the repaired class \(\mathcal M_{N,T,\mathbf n}\), while estimating the full donor covariance \(\Sigma\) and accommodating calendar dependence?  The proposed handle is the ordered modulus of the joint treated-outcome, replicated fixed-design regression, and covariance-standardized donor-location product experiment.
body.justification: Rate comparison does not determine the joint least-favorable experiment or its exact constants at channel intersections.
body.gap: The repaired fixed-design optimal-recovery frontier leaves simultaneous exact constants with generated donor locations and calendar dependence unresolved.
body.consumer: An exact solution would calibrate sampling allocation and interval length at boundaries between replication and proxy-location difficulty.
